name: cancelReservation
intent: Cancel the selected user's reservation for the selected book copy.
pre: A user with the supplied uid exists.
A book copy with the supplied barcode exists.
The copy is marked as reserved.
A reservation linking this user and copy exists.
post: Mark the selected reservation as closed.
difficulty_basis: Existing user/copy/reservation lookup with two unconditional flag updates.
scenarios: Reserved flag cleared, reservation closed, true result asserted; NORMAL and suspension zero in setup are not reference guards.
effects_audit: Reservation is closed, not deleted; no association removal or copy availability change inferred.
